Moderation detects flagged content

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.moderationRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"I want to hurt someone very badly\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.moderate(_req)
debugPrint(result.results)
debugPrint(result.results[0].flagged)
```
